name: Flip Deck Grid
description: Responsive grid of image cards where each card is a page-flip deck that turns images like a book page with 3D folds and shadows, controlled by arrows, swipe, keyboard or autoplay.
contents: Grid of cards, each with a label, title, page counter, flip deck of images and progress bar
Previous and next arrow buttons per card
behavior: Images flip like book pages with perspective, fold shadows and configurable speed and easing
Navigation by arrows, horizontal swipe, arrow keys when a card is focused, or optional autoplay that pauses on hover
Arrows appear on hover or focus, and always show on touch devices
Images are split into decks automatically or supplied as explicit decks
editableByProps: Images, deck grouping, titles, labels and number of columns
Flip direction, speed, easing, shadow strength, looping and autoplay timing
Counter, progress bar, arrows, swipe and keyboard toggles
All background, card, border, text and accent colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change arrow button icons or styling
needsCodeEdit.where: Previous page and Next page buttons inside the Deck component

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the card header or footer layout
needsCodeEdit.where: header and footer elements inside the Deck component

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the perspective depth of the flip
needsCodeEdit.where: perspective value in the .bb-bookblock rule of the css template

fixed: Section fills at least the viewport height with its own background color and page padding
Flip uses DOM cloning of item markup, so deck items should be images only
Decks built from images drop any trailing images that do not fill a full deck
